title: Platform Automation
content: Complete guide to TYT Platform v2 automation tools, commands, and workflows for efficient development.

items.title: Server Management
items.what: Start/stop/status PHP server for local development
items.how: make serve (start+open), make stop, make status

items.title: Documentation Workflow
items.how: make new-doc category=guides slug=my-note; make validate

items.title: Entity Scaffolding
items.why: Fast entity module creation with consistent patterns
items.what: Generate entity modules from ES5 templates
items.how: make new-entity name=storage category=common description='Storage helper'

items.title: Project Scaffolding
items.why: Quick project initialization with standard structure
items.what: Generate complete project structure (www/, data/, deploy/)
items.how: make new-project name=my-app → opens skeleton at projects/my-app/

items.title: History Logging
items.why: Track all platform actions and changes
items.how: make history-add action='feature:add' msg='Description'; make history-show

items.title: Version Management
items.why: Semantic versioning with git tags and changelog
items.what: Create git tags, update HISTORY.md automatically

items.title: Validation Scripts
items.what: Check JSON docs for required fields (id/category/title/items)

items.title: Complete Makefile Commands
items.why: Single source of truth for automation
items.how: make help → lists: serve, stop, status, open-doc, validate, new-doc, new-entity, new-project, version, history-add, history-show

items.title: Workflow Best Practices
items.what: 1) make serve → 2) create entity/project → 3) validate → 4) log history → 5) version tag
items.how: Always validate before committing; log significant changes; use templates for consistency
